title: For players
description: Watch your matches back, follow your stats, work with your coach, ask coaches about your game and buy and sell padel gear. Free, on any phone or computer.
heading: For players
line: Your matches, your coach and your padel community in one place.

heroShot.alt: A player's home page on a phone: shots, plays and tagged matches

features.heading: Your matches and stats
features.body: Tag a match from the video, or track it from the side of the court, and see where points were won and lost. Every match you save adds to your stats, so you can see what is changing over time.

shot.alt: The Match Tagger with a tagged match and its report

features.heading: Your coach
features.body: Link your account to your coach and their sessions, homework, ratings and clips land on your page. Message them, send a voice note, or send a clip of your own and ask what they think.

shot.alt: A player's own My page: shots sent to the coach, plays and tagged matches

features.heading: Ask a coach, and the Community
features.body: Post a question about your game, add a clip if you have one, and coaches answer. You can ask anonymously, and in the Community you can share a result, find a game and join groups with the people you play with.

shot.alt: The Community: questions, results and a tagged match

features.heading: My rackets and Balance
features.body: Add the rackets you play with and keep their real weight and balance. The Balance Calculator shows what a strip of tape will do before you stick it on.

shot.alt: The Balance Calculator with tape on a racket

features.heading: Marketplace
features.body: Buy and sell rackets, bags and shoes with other players and coaches. Rackets come with the seller's real weighing, every sale gets a review, and you can star a listing to hear when the price drops.

shot.alt: The Marketplace with rackets and gear for sale

features.heading: Box League on your phone
features.body: If your club runs its box league here, your box, your matches and the table are on your phone. Book each match with the other three, and watch the results come in as they are played.

shot.alt: A player's box in a box league, on a phone

faq.a: Yes. A player account is free, and so are the tools.

Not for the tools: the Match Tracker, Scoreboard, Tactics Board and Balance Calculator all work without one. An account keeps your matches and stats in one place, links you to your coach and lets you post in the Community.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. It runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer, so there is nothing to install. The Match Tagger is the exception: it needs a laptop or computer.

A video you tag from a file never leaves your device. A coach you link to sees your saved matches and stats, and only the clips you choose to send them. Nothing goes in the Community unless you post it.

faq.q: How do I link up with my coach?
faq.a: Ask your coach for their invite link and set up your account from it, or open the link to the page your coach keeps for you and link your account from there.
